name: @guardbee/mcp-llm-redteam
description: MCP server that red-teams a live LLM endpoint or chatbot with canary-based jailbreak/extraction/obfuscation probes to test whether known bypass techniques defeat its guardrails
long_description: Sends a battery of publicly documented jailbreak, system-prompt-extraction, obfuscation, refusal-suppression, and multilingual override techniques to a live LLM API (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic) or your own chatbot webhook. Every probe is canary-based: it never asks the target to produce genuinely harmful content — success is measured by whether the target reproduces a random, single-use token, proving an out-of-character instruction was obeyed. Only point this at an endpoint you own or are explicitly authorized to test; every probe consumes API quota on the target.
